correctness.rationale: Uniform block-to-target injection gives the exact joint event probability prod(s_i)/(n)_r and hence factorial moments. A head/tail logarithmic product bound on H_n(t) proves locally uniform convergence to exp(delta*t)prod(1+a_i*t); Cauchy coefficients and moment determinacy yield distributional convergence. Diagonal extraction establishes all subsequential profiles; an explicit floor-and-singleton construction realizes every admissible profile. Uniform fourth-moment bounds and the exact variance prove necessity of the largest-fibre criterion. Independent finite enumeration passed 278 partition cases, 1154 exact factorial-moment comparisons and 54 asymptotic comparisons. Infinite results do not rely on finite tests.

value.rationale: The number of mapping self-loops is a fundamental local structural count. Prescribing all collisions/fibres forces dependent sampling, yet the limiting law has a complete Poisson-dust/Bernoulli-macrofibre decomposition. Its iff criterion tells precisely when classical Poisson(1) behavior survives arbitrary deterministic collision heterogeneity; all possible limit profiles are realized. This distinguishes a meaningful structural phase boundary from the already-elementary exact factorial enumeration and has potential use as a diagnostic for random mapping models with large collision classes.
